summary: First Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: FNLC), a Maine bank holding company, filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.38 per share, payable October 16, 2026 to holders of record October 6, 2026. No special-situation transaction is present. Management noted an annualized $1.52 per share dividend equates to a 4.47% yield based on the September 23, 2026 close of $33.98. This is ordinary capital return activity, not an activist, tender, or strategic event; watch for continued quarterly declarations and payout sustainability.
